notes.title: Project 3 Reveal - "Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room"
notes.content:
[h3]DEVBEEF Project 3:[/h3]
[h1][i]Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room[/i][/h1]

Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room is a community run experimental story game. With the end of the world fast approaching, Dr. Gumphrey Finklestein announces his plans for a groundbreaking scientific experiment. What will it entail? Does even he know?

[previewyoutube=rD9H_78Z6sY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]TODAY[/b] BEGINS THE MARVELOUS ROOM EXPERIMENT... Phase 1. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/d753aaa9b1fd4135cf5d34710bc9d8f7d79f31c9.png[/img]

For those who don't understand (or those who just didn't watch the trailer) this game will be heavily influenced by the Community. For [i]Title_Pending[/i], we had the dev-ideas channel in our Discord, and for the year and a half it was open... not a single idea was used. This got us thinking, what if we made a game where we were [b]forced[/b] to use the ideas you lunatics come up with?

[h3]The Experiment will be run in the DEVBEEF Discord server. If you would like to participate, join here:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/792d958f367320ecb71c7fe76de224fac7d2e684.png[/img]

[url=https://devbeef.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/6e04019bfe8cd6b9c8d7ed9c229155ae1363b164.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/792d958f367320ecb71c7fe76de224fac7d2e684.png[/img]

[h2]We hope to see you there![/h2]

notes.title: Title_Pending Development Log #1 - What We've Been Up To
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone, and welcome to our first [b]Development Log[/b]![/h1]

This is the first of hopefully many logs we'll be doing in the build up to the release of Title_Pending. We'll be using these to show off some of the stuff we've been working on, share progress, and more! Since this is the first one we've done, we won’t be showing too much, but hopefully you still enjoy.

[h3]Here's the Video Version:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=rFLrP_K5SeU;full][/previewyoutube]
Note: New Music is only available here!

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]

[h2]STANTON SODA™[/h2]
As we've teased on our twitter (go follow that btw) we've made the Stanton Soda™ vending machines functional. Now if you interact with one, it'll spit out an official JMC Branded Stanton Soda™ can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/78aa7508cc115f1b277ca91c071f6c2c59da9b79.gif[/img]

There's no limit on the amount of cans you can spawn, so go nuts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/0139e2a320759dc5e1e5579e9545ed68e9665ba5.gif[/img]

There's even a chance you'll hear a [b][url=https://youtu.be/rFLrP_K5SeU?t=54]jingle[/url][/b] after purchasing a can!

[h2]QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES[/h2]

Here's some of the other quality of life changes and additions we've made since the demo:

[list]
[*] The Pause Menu now actually pauses the game, including Music and Dialogue
[*] Camera Bobbing can now be toggled
[*] The HUD Scanline effect can also be toggled
[*] There's now a streamer mode option that will prevent the game from using your PC name
[*] File chunking has been enabled, which splits the game into multiple pak files, to allow for easier updating
[*] Level Streaming has been implemented, which gives a sizable boost to performance across all specs [b](demonstration below)[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/312d691ab0d54b4255373d8b7ba28b27180c93a8.gif[/img]

[h2]PROGRESS[/h2]

We've recently hit a pretty big milestone, as we've finished up the finale of the game. Hopefully you all enjoy it when the game releases!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/359f0348342fd349fbaf67cf8d93b4e8b75bd68c.png[/img]

Currently, we're working on fleshing out the story, adding loads of extra content, and of course, fixing bugs. We can't share much yet, but let's just say there's gonna be a lot of secrets to find once you get your hands on the full release...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/d984658034a73813af1af90708f5c628afc527d9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/ef35e3afc715b684f950a6364f16fe96c3344ca3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/be32d03a3d3d2f4e769515b91c478af8dd535d28.png[/img]

[h2]QNA[/h2]

Last, but not least, we'll be opening a QNA channel on our discord. If you have any questions that you wanna ask the devs, just drop it in there, and we'll answer them in upcoming dev logs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39844127/ee170afd6dfcb750a61642576562cb4f77c72703.png[/img]
We'll try our best to answer every question we can.

[h2][url=https://discord.gg/XgcgUHJ]Here's our Discord[/url][/h2]
(if you haven't joined already)

[h2]Thank you for reading, and be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1288900/Title_Pending/]wishlist Title_Pending[/url] if you haven't already![/h2]
